details: Malicious package. `@dancihuy/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Defaults/index.js` defines `DEFAULT_AUTO_FOLLOW_CHANNELS` containing the hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363413556377369@newsletter, and `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` issues an authenticated `w:mex` newsletter FOLLOW mutation for it on the first successful connection, silently subscribing the victim account. The behaviour is enabled by default. In addition, `lib/Socket/luxu.js`, imported by `messages-send.js`, stamps outgoing event and poll-result messages with forwarded-newsletter context naming channel 120363421563597486@newsletter. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Version 0.0.1 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
